rationale: The target faithfully represents numbered equation (7): it uses the operator 2-norm of I-Q_k^TQ_k, the exact c4 coefficient, the square of the inverse-based condition number of the computed leading R block, and one-based prefixes k=1,...,n. The family and run structures preserve the full-rank real rectangular setup and specifically trace Algorithm 2's pythagorean diagonal. Equations (4)-(6) appear in the residual-asymptotics argument in precisely the roles used by the appendix. The main difference is deliberate strengthening: the paper suppresses O(epsilonM^2), whereas Lean supplies a uniform radius and explicit quadratic remainder coefficient. Therefore Lean implies the selected paper conclusion under its first-order convention, but the displayed paper statement does not entail the exact formal remainder package.
